hero.lead: A nation of 255.2 million on the Indus, which has drawn $4.8 billion from the IMF since 2024 and rebuilt its reserves to $16 billion.

capital.heading: Pakistan has rebuilt its reserves review by review. Next, every child reading by ten.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 40 in every hundred live in towns and cities; the rest live on the land they farm and fish.
items.alt: A busy bazaar street in Lahore

items.name: The Land
items.label: Of land in farms and pasture
items.text: The land that feeds the nation, and the first place a citizen dividend can be earned.
items.alt: Wheat fields on the irrigated plains of Punjab, Pakistan

items.name: The Cities
items.label: Live in towns and cities
items.text: Dense cities make every pipe, cable and clinic serve more people for each dollar spent.
items.alt: The modern skyline of Karachi, Pakistan, at dusk

items.name: The Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water per person
items.text: Below the scarcity line of 1,000 cubic metres: every drop must be stored, treated and reused.
items.alt: The Indus River flowing through the mountains of northern Pakistan

items.name: The Power
items.label: Of energy from renewables, 2021
items.text: Sun, wind, water and biomass already carry part of the load; the rest is the opportunity.
items.alt: Wind turbines of the Jhimpir wind corridor in Sindh, Pakistan

items.name: The enterprises building Perfect Pakistan
items.text: The Stewards are verifying the companies and social enterprises already delivering the seven basic living standards in Pakistan. Suggest one to include.
